about: ADR-0208: the rows the Definition of Done checks by hand, the code each covers, and each row's latest record. A row's record holds while its paths are unchanged between the commit the record was made at and the commit being signed off; the release workflow checks it (tools/release/ExGrid.Release, ByHand) and refuses a version without a suffix, and a release candidate, when a row's paths changed since its record, when its latest record is not a pass, or when it has none. The rows and paths are the Definition of Done's Step 4 table, 'Rows checked by hand, and the code each covers', word for word: tests/ExGrid.Release.Tests holds the two together. A record is the file under verification/ that gives the row's verdict, and the commit it names as verified, in full. A run that records a row replaces its record here, in the same commit as the record; 'record' is null for a row never recorded. 'note' is for a reader and is not read by the check.

rows.note: The fifteenth Windows run's Part A: scrollbar.spec.mjs's VZ-14 block at 150%, on both browsers and both hosts. 125% was not run, and the row has named 150% since its rewrite of 2026-10-01.

Never checked as written. The eleventh run's Part C read lines at a real devicePixelRatio of 2.25 (verification/2026-10-02-windows-excel-11c/beside-excel.md) before ADR-0090 decided the Device Pixel, and read neither a zoom told as it changes nor VZ-16's thin line and gridline.

Never measured on Windows: tests/GlyphWidths holds *.macos.json records only, and its README leaves Windows' system-ui (Segoe UI) out of the tables until a record from Windows is added. The row keeps the measurement until that record, system-ui.windows.json, is committed and held by layer 1.
The macOS glyph widths are measured (tests/GlyphWidths/*.macos.json, held by layer 1), but no record under verification/ names a commit at which a bold amount and #### were read painted on macOS.

The sixteenth Windows run gave no verdict by row. Its differences 1 and 3 read against ED-30's statement (keys typed after a composition's end lost one on WebAssembly; a press on D12 mid-composition never reached the page), so its record is not a pass.

The eleventh run's Part B, the run the row names: Ctrl+1 to Ctrl+5 reached a standalone keys.html in Chrome and Edge, and no tab was selected. Never read on ExSheet; the seventeenth run's Part D reads them on /sheet.
Never checked by hand (ADR-0202): the seventeenth run's Part D is its first.

The macOS records under verification/ are layer-3 runs' metrics.json and console.json, which name no commit (2026-09-23 to 2026-10-01), a targeted run of other specs (2026-10-03) and measurements; none names the commit of a layer-3 run on macOS that this row could hold on.

Checked on 2026-10-08 on that PC against a v0.1.0-beta.2 build carrying the repaint, published to the Docs Site (ADR-0012's note), but no record under verification/ names its commit; verification/2026-10-09-windows-remote-isolation/README.md records the investigation that followed, not the row.

The sixteenth run's Part D listened under Narrator for the wording. Where DOM focus is after an arrow key, under NVDA and Narrator, with and without a Focus, which is the check §21.11 names since 2026-10-11, has not been run: the seventeenth run's Part F is its first.
